Procedure performed
Diagnostic colonoscopy with ileal intubation and biopsies.

Indications
Chronic diarrhea and abdominal cramping; evaluate for inflammatory bowel disease or microscopic colitis.

Description of procedure
The adult colonoscope was advanced through the colon to the cecum. The terminal ileum was intubated and examined for 10 cm. The bowel preparation was excellent.

Findings
The terminal ileum appeared normal; biopsies were obtained from the terminal ileum.
The colonic mucosa appeared normal throughout. Random biopsies were taken from the right colon and left colon to evaluate for microscopic colitis.

Impression
Normal ileocolonoscopy; biopsies obtained.

Plan
Follow up biopsy results by phone in one week.
